name: Zhào Péngyou
description: Zhào Péngyou ('Finding Friends') is a Chinese multi-player trick-taking game. 5-12 players. Multiple decks + jokers. Trump maker 'calls' specific cards — holders become secret partners (kankei). Point cards: 5=5pts, 10/K=10pts (100 total). Teams level up through ranks. First to Ace level wins.

content.text: Zhào Péngyou ('Finding Friends') is a Chinese multi-player trick-taking game. 5-12 players. Multiple decks + jokers. Trump maker 'calls' specific cards — holders become secret partners (kankei). Point cards: 5=5pts, 10/K=10pts (100 total). Teams level up through ranks. First to Ace level wins.

Zhào Péngyou (Looking for Friends) is a Chinese trick-taking game in the Shēng Jí (升级, raise level) family, alongside Dă Băi Fēn (打百分, 100) and Tractor (拖拉机). These games share level-as-card-rank progression and King-Ten-Five point scoring. The variant with variable, secret partnerships called by the trump maker is popular across China and is one of the few trick-taking games that scales well to 6–12 players. The aim is to win tricks containing Kings, Tens and Fives while teammates are revealed only when the called cards are played.
Multiple decks with jokers. 54 cards per deck.

items.text: Active and Passive Scores: Only active players (winners of previous hand) may make trumps; defenders win at 40 per pack with no middle zone.
Number of Cards and Size of Kitty: Some use fixed 6-card kitty; others allow 8-card kitty or vary jokers to get close to 6.
Trump suit tractors above Ace: Some allow tractors to continue above ace in trump suit (e.g. 4s and diamonds: A-A-4-4 as tractor).
